info.title: PDLwatch Access Copilot
info.description: Answers questions about US state Medicaid preferred drug lists: where a drug is preferred or needs prior authorization, a state's coverage of a drug class, and what changed between PDL versions. Every status cites the document and page it was read from.

post.description: Answers one question about Medicaid drug coverage, PDL changes or extraction quality, using the analysis tools. Returns the answer and the tools it used.

get.summary: A drug's status in every state
get.description: Status (preferred, non-preferred with prior authorization, not covered), PA, step therapy and quantity limit in each state's latest PDL. Accepts a brand, a generic or an ingredient.

parameters.name: drug
parameters.description: Brand, generic or ingredient, e.g. Ozempic or semaglutide

200.description: Rows with a note; each status cites its document and page

get.description: Every product on a state's latest PDL, optionally one therapeutic class.

parameters.name: drug_class
parameters.description: Therapeutic class, e.g. GLP-1 or SGLT2

200.description: Rows with a note; each status cites its document and page

get.description: Status changes, additions, removals and quantity-limit changes between a state's consecutive PDLs.
